name: Omo-Ojo Olanrewaju
story: I'm Omo-Ojo Olanrewaju, a fresh Anatomy graduate from Ladoke Akintola University of Technology (LAUTECH).  In my 300 Level, I realized I needed to stop depending on my parents and start creating my own income. I tried referrals, airdrop farming, and other online hustles, but none of them worked out in fact, I was in debt to several loan apps at the time.  That struggle led me to this business. I learned digital skills, monetized them, and built a passive income stream. I started as a distributor and I'm now a Senior Manager.  Through this opportunity, I've been able to acquire business tools like a Dell Inspiron 13-5378, among other things. People on my team have also purchased phones and PCs, and are doing well financially now. Today, I earn monthly through my digital skills and network marketing. This opportunity has been a turning point and a blessing in my life.
